format: census-sources.json: registers and specialist catalogues read by census.py, one entry in `adapteurs` per source (see CENSUS.md).
id, nom, url: short id (cache key), name shown in `preuves`, home page. niveau: N1 register / N2 trade / N3 specialist / N4 free (STANDARD-SOURCES.md).
genres: genera the adapter applies to ("*" for all). registre: true if the source is a registration authority. delai: seconds between two requests.
licence: licence shown with the photos of the source. pages_max: most pages followed (default 60). GET only: no form, no POST, no account.

liste.urls: URL templates; {genre} {genre_lc} {taxon} {taxon_lc} {espece} {groupe} and the loop variable {n} (liste.iter {"n":[1,30]}, stops at the first empty page) or {lettre} (liste.iter {"lettre":"a-z"}).
liste.suivant: regex whose group 1 is the URL of the next page. liste.format: "html" (default) or "pdf" (text of the PDF, needs pdftotext, PyMuPDF or pypdf).

liste.entree: regex, or list of regexes. The first one makes an entry (html: one match = one entry; with liste.decoupe, the text is first cut at each match of decoupe and the first regex runs on each piece); the others only add groups still missing.

Named groups: nom (required), url, img, couleur, obtenteur, annee, groupe, espece ("orientalis", "S. vulgaris", "Syringa vulgaris"), syn (synonyms), x_<anything> (kept in `extra`). liste.flags: i s m x (default "is").
nettoyage_nom: [[regex, replacement], ...] applied to the name. legendes: {group: {code: text}} (couleur: codes inside the text are replaced). groupe_depuis: group used as horticultural group.
doutes_si: [{champ, regex, doute}] adds a doubt when a group matches. fiche: optional detail page of each entry ({url is the entry url}): {entree:[regex], images: regex, max: N}.
®, ™ and 'trademark' near a name are kept as `marque.indice`. Registers whose names are denominations: `registres_denomination` (a vendor sign on those names is not a doubt).

liste.post: urlencoded body of a read-only POST ({n} etc. filled), used only where the owner allowed it (JdW listing: no account, no personal data, >= 2 s between requests). liste.format "json": liste.chemin = dotted path of the list in the answer, liste.champs = {group: template with {dotted.path} or {dotted.path|slug} of each item}.
registre: true with niveau N1 marks a registration authority (ICRA): a vendor's ® on a name it registers is not a trademark doubt (the cultivar gets `registres`).
